subject: 🏃 Tuesday — Upper Push (Week 3)
html:
Today: Upper Push — Week 3 of 4, Chassis Build. 10 days to PT follow-up (May 15).

Short gym session today. Upper Push is your maintenance work — get in, hit the movements with good control, get out in ~25 minutes. No running today (upper and running never share a day). Still waiting on your knee feedback from the Apr 29, May 1, and May 3 runs — I need that before programming Thursday's run. Those paces (8:13 and 7:45/mi) were well above easy and both runs exceeded the 5-mile Chassis Build cap. If the knee is green, we move forward; if it's talking, Thursday becomes a bike.

Focus cue: Overhead press — brace your core hard before you press. No rib flare, no arching. Think about pulling your ribs down toward your belt before the DB leaves your shoulders.

Warm-up (rep-based):

  • Arm circles: 10 each direction
  • Shoulder rolls: 10 forward, 10 back
  • Scapular retractions: 10 reps
  • Cat-cow: 10 reps
  • Band pull-aparts: 10 reps
  • Dead hangs: 2 × 10 sec

Main Work — 3 × 10–12 each:

ExerciseWeightSets × Reps
Dumbbell bench press30 lbs/hand3 × 10–12
Overhead press25 lbs/hand3 × 10–12
Push-upsBodyweight3 × 10–12
Lateral raise10 lbs3 × 10–12
Tricep overhead extension25 lbs (single DB, two-handed)3 × 10–12

Context: You're in the back half of Chassis Build. The hip/core work Mon, Wed, Fri is the real training — upper days are about maintaining what you have so the marathon build phase (starting May 18) doesn't start from scratch on push/pull strength. Keep it honest but don't grind.
